theorems.name: Submission.dtc_approxTangent_of_null_diff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M M' V : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), M' ⊆ M → IsOpen V → x ∈ V → μHE[n] ((M \ M') ∩ V) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q
